metadata.title: Safe and Secure OT Operations

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating OT systems safely and securely in the presence of cyber and physical risk.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Operational Technology, Industrial Control Systems, and safety‑critical operational environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that OT systems are operated through safety‑aware, segmented, and controlled security practices.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Operational safety is the primary objective; cybersecurity controls must preserve deterministic and fail‑safe behavior.

metadata.remarks: Safe and Secure OT Operations is a composite pattern asserting that operational technology systems are governed, accessed, modified, and commanded in a manner that preserves human safety, environmental protection, and process stability while resisting cyber threats. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent OT capability patterns are realized.

components.title: OT Core
components.description: Definition and classification of OT systems, safety criticality, and baseline operational assumptions.

components.title: Safety Zones and Conduits
components.description: Segmentation of OT systems into safety‑aligned zones with explicitly controlled communication conduits.

components.title: Engineering Access Control
components.description: Restriction, governance, and monitoring of engineering and privileged access to OT systems.

components.title: OT Change Management
components.description: Safety‑preserving authorization, testing, and audit of changes to OT logic and configuration.

components.title: Command Integrity
components.description: Validation of authenticity, integrity, and safe execution of commands sent to OT systems.
